task.title: Validate a profile
task.shortdesc: Run schema-aware validation before saving, exporting, or comparing policy changes.

prereq.p: Open BPM in the browser and keep a profile, Library, All Settings, Guided, JSON, or Compare surface available.

context.p: Validation checks policy names, value shapes, supported schema channel, unsupported ESR-only differences, and raw or unknown entries visible in BPM.

step.cmd: Open the profile in Guided, All Settings, or JSON.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Confirm the selected Firefox schema channel before validating.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Run validation or review the visible validation panel on the active surface.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Resolve unsupported policies, wrong value types, unknown raw entries, or stale imported values before treating the profile as ready.

info.note: Save or deliberately discard changes before leaving an editor, closing a tab, or confirming an irreversible action.

result.p: You know whether the profile is ready to save and export for the selected Firefox channel.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the visible state is unclear, stop editing, read the current status message, refresh once, and reopen the profile from the Library.
